editorial.name: ImgGen AI
editorial.descriptionZh: 免费文生图站，另配了一整套修图工具（去背景、去水印、放大、上色、去物体）。页面上写 200K+ 创作者、2M+ 张图，出图无水印。
editorial.takeawayZh: 写提示词免费出图，要修图就去同一个工具区挑
editorial.noteZh: 首屏是白底，最上一排是 AI Image Generator / Upscale Image / More Tools / API / Pricing，右边 Sign in 与绿色 Sign up。正中一颗浅绿胶囊写 Trusted by 200K+ creators，下面两行大字 Free Online AI Image Generator。输入框 placeholder 是 Describe the image you want to generate...，右边绿色按钮 Generate→，下面一行 or surprise me，再下面排着 #001 Photorealistic、#002 Cinematic、#003 Fantasy、#004 Cyberpunk 四张示例。More Tools 菜单里摊开一长列：Background Remover、Image Text Remover、Watermark Remover、Retouch Photo、Colorize Image、AI Unblur Image、AI Face Enhancer、AI Object Remover 等二十多个。
editorial.pricing: Free to start, no watermark and no credit card; paid tiers not shown on the homepage

reasons.statement: 交付物是图片：首屏就是一句 prompt 加 Generate 按钮，页面自述 free online text-to-image generator that creates high-resolution, watermark-free images from written prompts。
归 image-vector-layout-creation 而不是素材库，是因为除出图外还有一整排编辑工具（/en/tools/unblur-image、/en/tools/watermark-remover、/en/tools/colorize-photo 等二十多个）。
